title: Privacy Policy
introduction: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy describes how CounterCtrl Cloud, a Data Enterprises, Inc. company (“CounterCtrl Cloud,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), collects, uses, stores, and shares personal information.

This Privacy Policy applies to counterctrlcloud.com and all other websites, applications, platforms, products, services, and tools operated by CounterCtrl Cloud where this Privacy Policy appears or is linked. Collectively, these are referred to as the “Services.”
By creating an account, providing information to us, accessing the Services, or continuing to use the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
IF YOU DO NOT AGREE WITH THIS PRIVACY POLICY OR OUR PRACTICES, YOU MAY NOT ACCESS OR USE THE SERVICES.

This Privacy Policy may change from time to time. Your continued use of the Services after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of those changes. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

sections.title: Personal Information We Collect
content: We may collect personal information that identifies, relates to, describes, or could reasonably be associated with an individual, consumer, household, business user, or account.

Certain personal information is required to provide the Services. If you do not provide the requested information, we may be unable to create your account, authenticate your access, provide certain features, respond to requests, or deliver our products and services.

categories.category: Category F: Internet or Electronic Network Activity

examples: General location information derived from an IP address may be collected for security, analytics, or service delivery purposes.

categories.category: Category H: Audio, Electronic, Visual, or Similar Information
Category I: Professional or Employment-Related Information
examples: Employment information submitted through a job application

We do not intentionally collect Social Security numbers, financial account credentials, health information, precise geolocation, biometric identifiers, or government-issued identification numbers through the ordinary operation of the Services.
We do not intentionally create consumer profiles reflecting psychological characteristics, personal preferences, intelligence, abilities, or similar personal traits.

sections.title: Business and Customer Data
content: CounterCtrl Cloud is a business analytics, reporting, data management, and operational intelligence platform.

Customers may provide or make available business information through the Services. This may include sales information, store information, product information, transaction data, invoice information, operational records, employee identifiers, cashier information, customer identifiers, or other business data.
Our customers are responsible for determining what data is submitted to the Services and for ensuring that they have the legal authority to collect, use, and provide that data.

When we process business or customer data on behalf of a customer, we generally act as a service provider or data processor. The customer remains responsible for its data collection practices, notices, permissions, and responses to requests from individuals whose information may be contained in customer data.
uses: Generate reports, analytics, dashboards, forecasts, and operational insights
Protect the security and integrity of the Services
Comply with contractual and legal obligations
Improve the performance and functionality of the Services

sections.title: Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies
content: Cookies are small text files stored by an internet browser on a computer or device.
purposes: Understand how the Services are used

cookie_types.name: Essential Cookies
cookie_types.description: These cookies are necessary for the core operation and security of the Services. They may support authentication, account access, session management, security, and access to protected areas.

cookie_types.name: Performance and Functionality Cookies
cookie_types.description: These cookies help improve the performance and functionality of the Services. They may remember user preferences and previously selected settings.

cookie_types.name: Analytics and Customization Cookies
cookie_types.description: These cookies help us understand how the Services are accessed and used.

sections.management: You may configure your browser to reject or remove certain cookies. Some Services or features may not function correctly when cookies are disabled. Essential cookies cannot be rejected because they are necessary to provide secure access to the Services.

sections.title: Do Not Track
content: Some browsers and devices offer a “Do Not Track” setting that signals a preference regarding online tracking.
There is currently no universally accepted standard for responding to these signals. At this time, our Services do not respond to Do Not Track browser signals.
If applicable laws require us to recognize a particular tracking preference signal, we will update our practices and this Privacy Policy accordingly.

sections.title: Promotional Communications
content: We may use your contact information to send you information about CounterCtrl Cloud products and services, product updates, new features, training opportunities, events, promotions, service announcements, and related Data Enterprises, Inc. products and services.
We do not sell personal information to organizations outside Data Enterprises, Inc. for their independent marketing purposes.
Even after opting out of promotional communications, you may continue to receive transactional, account, security, support, billing, or service-related communications.
opt_out_methods: Use the unsubscribe link included in an email
Reply “STOP” to an eligible text message
Contact us using the information in the How to Contact Us section

sections.title: Aggregated and De-Identified Information
content: We may aggregate, anonymize, or de-identify information so that it no longer reasonably identifies an individual, customer, store, or organization.
Aggregated and de-identified information is not treated as personal information under this Privacy Policy when it cannot reasonably be used to identify an individual.
We will not attempt to re-identify information that has been properly de-identified unless permitted or required by law.

recipients.name: Business Transactions

sections.title: Data Retention
content: We retain personal information while you maintain an account, your organization remains a customer, we provide products or services, or the information is needed for an authorized business purpose.

Retention periods may vary based on the type of information, the sensitivity of the information, the purpose for which it was collected, contractual requirements, customer instructions, and applicable law.
Customer data may be retained according to the applicable customer agreement, service order, data retention configuration, or documented customer instructions.
retention_reasons: Respond to questions, complaints, or claims
Comply with legal or regulatory obligations

sections.title: Children and the Services
content: The Services are intended for business use and are not directed to children.

You may not create an account or use the Services if you are under 18 years of age unless your use is specifically authorized by your employer, educational institution, parent, or legal guardian and permitted by applicable law.

We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected personal information directly from a child under 13 without appropriate authorization, we will take reasonable steps to delete the information.

sections.title: Keeping Personal Information Secure
content: We use reasonable and appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect information from unauthorized access, unauthorized use, loss, misuse, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Our security practices may include access controls, authentication procedures, monitoring, encryption, network protections, employee training, secure development practices, and vendor management procedures.

No system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Internet transmissions are not always secure and we cannot guarantee that information, searches, files, or communications will never be accessed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed.
Users are responsible for protecting their account credentials and promptly notifying us of suspected unauthorized account activity.

sections.title: Where Personal Information Is Stored
locations: By representatives and agents supporting our operations
content: Customer information may be stored in the United States or in another location used by our authorized service providers.

sections.title: Users Outside the United States
content: CounterCtrl Cloud and Data Enterprises, Inc. are headquartered in the United States and use service providers located in the United States.
The Services are primarily intended for customers and users in the United States.

When you access the Services from outside the United States, your personal information may be transferred to, stored in, or processed in the United States or another jurisdiction where we or our service providers operate.

Privacy laws in those jurisdictions may differ from the laws in your location. By using the Services and providing information to us, you acknowledge that your information may be processed in these jurisdictions as described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Third-Party Websites and Services
content: The Services may contain links to third-party websites, applications, integrations, or services.
We do not control and are not responsible for the privacy, security, products, services, content, or data practices of third parties.
A link to a third-party service does not constitute an endorsement of that service.
We encourage you to review the privacy policy and terms of any third-party service before providing it with personal information.
Questions, complaints, claims, or concerns regarding a third-party service should be directed to the operator of that service.

sections.title: Your Privacy Choices and Rights
content: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information.
These rights may be subject to legal exceptions and verification requirements.

When personal information is processed by CounterCtrl Cloud on behalf of a customer, you may need to submit your request directly to that customer. We may assist the customer with responding to the request as required by contract or law.
We will not unlawfully discriminate against you for exercising an applicable privacy right.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: This Privacy Policy was published on the Last Updated date shown above.
We may modify this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our Services, business practices, technology, applicable laws, or regulatory requirements.
Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
When required by law, we may provide additional notice through the Services, by email, or through another appropriate communication method.
